name: Sellye (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, yellow and blue in the ratio 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Sellye (a blue shield with a yellow plant, ears of grain and a rose) within a green wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
